newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bomb experts explode suspect car outside NATO HQ.
newsitem.headline: Bomb experts explode suspect car outside NATO HQ.

text.p: Belgian bomb disposal experts carried out controlled explosions late on Friday on a suspect car parked outside the Brussels headquarters of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation.
The vehicle, which carried no license plates, had been left in a car park just outside the Western alliance's security cordon, a NATO officer told Reuters.

Traffic backed up on the main road in from Brussels airport as a police bomb diposal team set off a series of explosions using a remote-controlled device to make sure the vehicle was not booby-trapped.
Police then towed the car away, the officer added.

NATO peacekeeping forces in Bosnia are on high alert for retaliatory attacks after British special forces arrested one war crimes suspect and shot dead another who resisted arrest last week in Prijedor, near Banja Luka.
Both men were wanted by the U.N. war crimes tribunal in the Netherlands.
